run_training: run a detectron2 training job using a lazyconfig YAML file and optional CLI overrides
run_evaluation: run evaluation only on a detectron2 model by loading a checkpoint and testing on the configured dataset
resume_training: resume a detectron2 training run from the latest checkpoint in the output directory
configure_multi_gpu: launch multi-GPU distributed training for a detectron2 model using the num_gpus argument
override_config: apply command-line overrides to a lazyconfig YAML file before training or evaluation
